title: ResourceId round-trips every supported IdStrategy
decision:
Canonical wire form is `<type>:<strategy>:<value>`. Strategy is `uuid`, `ulid` or
`integer`; UUID includes default UUIDv7 and other canonical UUID values, ULID is
canonical uppercase, integer is positive canonical decimal without leading zero.
`ResourceId` owns parse/render and configured-id factories, with type/strategy mismatch
errors and no database lookup. The prefix grants no authority.
rationale:
An external identifier must preserve the configured model key without lossy coercion or
an implicit dependency on one default strategy.
